about: Authored kits for the classic teams (b778-ss1): installed by nfl2k5_classic_teams, not by the Anniversary moment stage, because the classic-teams preset has the Anniversary moments off. The moment-kit composer reads this shape exactly as data/nfl2k5_moment_kits.json.

kits.look: 2006 Sarasota Seamen: teal jersey and pants at home, white jersey and pants on the road, white helmet with a teal stripe, green facemask, plain chest and sleeves, solid white (home) / teal (away) block numbers with no outline. Authored for b778-ss1 from the 2026 Dolphins cut (aqua -> #10B984, orange -> #101820), with the donor marks painted out, the Browns helmet shell recoloured white and its stripe teal.
